Note the tracker's direction accuracy is weak (0.343) despite a 0.646 hit rate, so this is a tilt-and-humble call, not a forecast.
emerging_watch: Watch Gold Miners vs Oil & Gas: if Gold Miners' score closes more than half of the current 0.502 rotation margin and its breadth expands above ~0.4, that would be the first sign of a confirmed leadership handoff — until then, Oil & Gas remains the leader.

Oil & Gas shows the strongest durability (0.68) and highest breadth (0.786), which suggests any trend-following allocation would stay allocated here. Crowding (z=1.04) is a size-down caution only; per guardrails, do not fade the leader.
evidence: gate_helps=true (absolute-trend risk control validated on this market)
theses.dissent: Crowding at z=1.04 plus a top momentum score often marks late-cycle attention; the tracker's 0.343 direction accuracy means this leadership can reverse hard, and 'mixed' hurst_tag signals trend coherence is fragile.

theses.subject: Gold Miners
theses.thesis: Gold Miners are the only credible challenger to Oil & Gas: rank 2, score 1.11, eligible, and uncrowded (z=0.2). Durability is moderate (0.48) and breadth is thin (0.267), so this is a secondary trend-following lean, not a handoff call. Under a trend-following, vol-aware discipline, this is the kind of theme the gate would de-risk or exclude.
